For today's lab, we will re-analyse the [debate between Jon Ossoff and Mike Collins](https://www.atlantanewsfirst.com/2026/10/09/read-full-transcript-us-senate-debate-between-jon-ossoff-mike-collins/) you analysed in the previous lab.

(if you used another source, use that one instead)

## Data

You can use the code below to directly scrape the debate transcript from the news source:

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(ellmer)

url <- "https://www.atlantanewsfirst.com/2026/10/09/read-full-transcript-us-senate-debate-between-jon-ossoff-mike-collins/"
ps <- read_html(url) |> 
  html_elements("p") |> 
   html_text2()
# Note: you probably used str_detect and str_extract. `separate` also is really useful here:
d <- tibble(par=seq_along(ps), text=ps) |>
  separate(text, into=c("speaker", "text"), sep=":\\s*", extra="merge", fill="left") |>
  filter(speaker %in% c("Jon Ossoff", "Mike Collins"))
head(d)
```
